tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal ye shes kyi mgon po bsnyen pa'i tshe dgos pa'i gong gnon bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// gang gi bsnyen byed shar ri'i phrag mthon por// 'khor lo sdom pa nyi ma'i gdung byed 'dzin// de nas mgon po'i pad+mo rnam rgod pas// 'phrin las dri bzang phyogs kyi khong 'dir rgyas// dpal ye shes kyi mgon po'i bsnyen dus dgos pa'i yi ge nyung du zhig dgod par bya ste/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang*// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' che// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs kun// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// deng nas brtsams te mgon med bdag /byang chub snying po ma thob bar// 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa chen po las// bdag dang 'gro rnams skyabs pa'i phyir// rkang gnyis gtso bo sku gsum bdag /bcom ldan 'das la skyabs su mchi// 'dod chags bral zhing mya ngan 'das// zhi ba'i chos la skyabs su mchi// tshogs kyi mchog gyur sa la bzhugs// phyir mi ldog la skyabs su mchi// sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// bla ma mchog la skyabs su mchi// dngos grub ster ba'i yi dam lha// dkyil 'khor lha la skyabs su mchi// dpa' bo dpa' mo rnal 'byor ma// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa'i// gnyug ma'i sems la skyabs su mchi// bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyis// sngon chad sdig pa ci bgyis pa// mgon po khyod kyi spyan sngar bshags// phyin chad sdig las ldog par bgyi// deng nas khyod kyi 'bangs su mchi// khyod kyi bslab bya rjes su slob// khyod kyi bka' las mi 'da' bas// kun nas yongs su bskyab tu gsol// zhes skyabs 'gro lan gsum/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad ltar// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos rnams sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god//

ces sems bskyed lan gsum/ rang gi phung khams skye mched thams cad lhar gsal ba'i spyi bor seng ges bteg pa rin po che'i khri/ pad+ma dang*/ zla ba dang*/ nyi ma dang*/ dar gyis klubs pa'i gdan gyi steng du/ bla ma dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rnam par bzhugs pa'i spyi bo nas yar brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams mtho brtsegs kyi tshul du bzhugs shing*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa sprin gtibs pa'i tshul du bzhugs par gyur/ bdag gi lus dang longs spyod thams cad dang*/ mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba ma lus kun// skyes mchog khyed kyi 'bangs su 'bul lags na// thugs rjes dgongs te bzhes nas skyabs tu gsol// ston pa gsang bdag in+d+ra bhu ti dang*// klu yi rnal 'byor ma dang sā ra ha// klu sgrub 'phags pa lha dang klu'i byang chub// dus zhabs che chung rdo rje gdan pa dang*// a bha ya dang tsa mi dpal lga lo// tshul khrims 'byung gnas rdo rje dbang phyug dang*// phag gru zhang dang gling ras gtsang pa rgya// seng ge'i mtshan dgu bsam rgyal kha che dang*// rigs gsum rnam 'phrul rgyal dbang rje yab sras// chos kyi grags pa yon tan ye shes zhabs// chos rgyal lhun grub mthu chen rgyal ba'i mtshan// bdud 'joms dpa' bo pad+ma dkar po dang*// ngag dbang bzang dang mi pham chos kyi rje// dpag bsam dbang po kun dga' lhun grub dang*// chos kyi dbang phyug kun dga' bstan 'dzin rje// chos rgyal rgya mtsho khyab bdag mthu stobs dbang*// dge legs rin chen sgrub brgyud shing rta'i sde// gzhan yang mgon po'i dbang rgyud man ngag gi /bla ma kun la snying nas gsol ba 'debs// bstan srung mthu dang dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas bla ma rnams 'od du zhu rang gi spyi bor thim par gyur/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang phrad na ci ma rung snyam pa'i byams pa dang*/

sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral na ci ma rung snyam pa'i snying rje dang*/ sems can thams cad bde ba de yang rgyun brtan na ci ma rung snyam pa'i dga' ba dang*/ sems can thams cad yang dag pa'i lam la gnas na ci ma rung snyam pa'i btang snyoms la gnas par bya'o// oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bha wa shud+dho3haṃ/ bdag dang dngos po'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las ri rab kyi steng du sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la/ rang nyid skad cig gis dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lhan cig skyes pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan dmar mo'i snying ga mnan pa/ g.yon cung zad bskum pas 'jigs byed sngon po'i dpral ba mnan pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ mche ba cung zad gtsigs shing spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ nor bu dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ zla ba phyed pas mtshan pa'i ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu brgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ rus pa'i phyag rgya drug gis brgyan cing*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa'o// de'i pang na yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ gcer bu skra grol zhing*/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ thod skam lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing*/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pas mtshan pa'i phyag g.yon pas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud cing*/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub steng gi nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ zhabs g.yas yab la 'khyud cing g.yon yab dang lhan cig tu brkyang ba/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur pa'i spyi bor pad zla'i gdan la bla ma mi bskyod pa'i gzugs can gyis dbu brgyan cing thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig sngon pos mtshan par gyur/

thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ 'gro ba ma lus pa'i don byas/ tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ la sngags kyi phreng bas yongs su bskor bar gyur/ ces chu las chu sbur lta bur stong pa nyid las sa bon med par skad cig gis ldang bar bya'o// de ltar bsgoms nas slar snod bcud rnams rang gi lus la/ lus yas mas nas rim gyis snying ga'i hūm̐/ de ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin yin la/ de yang zhabs kyu ha/ zla tshes/ thig le/ nā da me long la has btab pa 'du ba ltar bsgoms nas thams cad stong pa 'od gsal la mnyam par bzhag cing*/ mi gnas na 'od gsal de las chu las nya ldang ba lta bur sngar ji lta bar langs te snying ga'i sa bon gyi mthar/ oṃ hrīḥ ha ha hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces pas bskor te ngag tu bzla la/ de'i tshe sngags bcas 'od zer gyi rtse la dpal 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum gyi sku bzhugs pa/ 'jig rten gsum na spros/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi sdig pa sbyangs/ dge ba la bkod pa'i mthar 'khor lo sdom pa'i go 'phang grub ste 'od zer slar 'dus par bsam mo// de nas/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pa ya gṛh+ṇa pa ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ āḥn ya hoḥ bha ga wan badz+ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces lan gsum/ thugs ka nas khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros te spos chu la thim pas khro bo rnams chu'i rnam par gyur pa des dngos po gang la'ang gtor zhing reg pas nyes skyon gyi dri ma dag par byed pa rnam par mi rtog pa'i chur gyur/ bsang chu byin rlabs/ ha ho hrīḥ lhan skyes dkar po'i thugs kar ha dkar po de las 'od 'phros/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug /ha la thim/ ha lha dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas kha dog phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur/ ha ho hrīḥ lhan skyes dmar po'i thugs kar ho dmar po de las 'od 'phros/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug

/ho la thim/ ho lha dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas dri phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur/ ha ho hrīḥlhan skyes sngon po'i thugs kar hrīḥ sngon po de las 'od 'phros/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug /hrīḥl thim/ hrīḥ lha dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas ro bcud phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bdud rtsi byin rlabs/ phaṭ/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ ma gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa yang dag pa dang*/ bden pa chen po 'di'i byin gyis brlabs kyis rnal 'byor pa bdag gi lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i mthu la brten nas bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa 'di zhes bgyi ba dpon slob yon mchod rnams kyis bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa ma lus pa'i mthu stobs kyi spyi gzugs/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po ma hā kā la lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la mchod pa 'bul zhing 'phrin las gnyan po bcol ba'i dus 'dir/ 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin pa sngags nyan pa la mi mos shing phyag rgya blta ba la mi dbang ba'i bdud bgegs bar du gcod par byed pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di khyer la myur ba nyid du phyir dengs shig /gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag ye shes kyi rdo rje me rab tu 'bar bas mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par gyur ta re/ hūm̐/ nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren tshogs// nga yi bka' las ma 'da' zhig /gal te bka' las 'das pa na// rdo rje me ltar 'bar ba yis// mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas shing*// brlag par 'gyur ba gdon mi za// de yi nyen la ma bsdo bar// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di khyer la// myur ba nyid du phyir dengs shig

/oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pa ya gṛh+ṇa pa ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ āḥn ya hoḥ bha ga wan badz+ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ hūm̐/ bdag nyid dpal chen skur gyur te// dpal 'bar khros pa'i thugs ka nas// hūm̐ las spros pa'i me dpung 'bar// kha dog sna lnga cher 'bar bas// steng yang me yi bla bre la// me yi thog dang ser chen 'bab// 'og kyang me yi sa gzhi la// me yi rdo rje gcal du bkram// phyogs mtshams me yis gtams pa la// me yi 'du 'phro skar ltar 'khrug /me phung 'bar ba'i tshwa tshwa rnam par 'phro// 'dod chags 'joms pa'i me ni dmar nag 'bar// zhe sdang 'joms pa'i me ni mthing nag 'bar// gti mug 'joms pa'i me ni smug nag 'bar// nga rgyal 'joms pa'i me ni ser nag 'bar// phrag dog 'joms pa'i me ni ljang nag 'bar// ye shes lnga ldan log 'dren 'joms mdzad pa'i// 'bar ba me yi mtshams las ma 'da' zhig/ de nas chu dang bdud rtsi dkyil 'khor la gtor te bsnyen pa'i yi ge la 'jug par bya'o// pad+ma dkar pos so/// / ༄༅// dpal mgon po'i gsang ba'i gsol 'debs ni/ hoḥ dgongs su gsol lo/ dpal rdo rje mgon po 'jigs byed chen po he ru ka dang rang bzhin chos nyid du gcig pa/ ngo bo ye shes su mtshungs pa/ mtshan nyid 'phrin las thogs med du mnyam pa/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad 'joms pa'i dpa' bo/ snang srid lha 'dre kun gyi yang rje/ zhing skyong drag po las gnyan gyi ded dpon/ mi pham rdo rje gzi brjid kyi rgyal po/ rig 'dzin gyi rnal 'byor bu bzhin du skyong ba/ dam can sgrub pa po'i bsam gtan gyi drod nyul ba/ zhi ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ rgyas pa'i byin chags pa/ dbang sdud las kyi rtsal mnga' ba/ drag po dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i las la myur ba/ bstan pa bsrung ba la rtsal 'byin pa/ mthu dang stobs kyi dbang phyug rdo rje drag rtsal can bdag la dgongs su gsol/

bdag rdo rje 'dzin pas ming 'di zhes bgyi bas btsugs pa'i phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rten 'di la brtan par bzhugs la/ rnal 'byor pa bdag bla na med pa'i byang chub/ bde ba chen po'i zhing khams bgrod pa'i lam gyi bar chad bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa las sgrol ba'i skyel ma mdzod cig yang dag pa'i lam la 'khrid pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi bsun ma dang phrad par mdzod cig de ltar byang chub ma thob bar du yang lus ngag yid gsum log pa'i lam la mi 'jug cing*/ thar pa byang chub kyi phyogs su blo 'gro bar mdzad du gsol/ 'jig rten 'dir yang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal zhing*/ bkra shis dang bde legs kyis gnas nas/ ci bsams pa lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol lo// mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thogs pa med par thob nas/ 'gro ba yongs kyi dpal dang mgon du 'gyur bar mdzad du gsol/ dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du 'phrin las kyi bya ba la gsol ba ji ltar btab pa bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol lo// dpal chen po lga los n+ya gro dha'i tshal du bsam gtan la mnyam par bzhag pa'i dus su/ rdo rje mgon po zhal gzigs pa'i tshe gsang ba'i gsol 'debs 'di mdzad pas byin rlabs khyad par 'phags pa'o// ye dharma he tu pra bha wā he tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya wa data/ te ṣañca yo ni ro dha e waṃ wā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥ bkra shis/// /
